يلتحقوا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَحِقُوا (yaltaḥiqū) /jal.ta.ħi.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# يُلْتَحَقُوا (yultaḥaqū) /jul.ta.ħa.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
